summary: Scenery object that scrolls back and forth along a line (e.g. moving clouds/water/background props), driven by ls::ScrollingObjectsSystem (Toolkit GameEngine.dll): offset = Start + Direction * Length * frac((Speed * Time + Phase) / Length); the system also culls by a sphere of the object's bound radius against camera frustums.

fields.name: Start
fields.evidence: ls::ScrollingObjectsSystem::CalculateOffset (GameEngine.dll+0x6342D0) returns [0..2] + Direction*Length*frac; the system's creation path (Update, GameEngine.dll+0x6349A0) copies it from the template data +0x130/+0x138. Live: world coordinates (-380/-660/-7000, 25/26/-580, -100/-559/-585).

fields.name: Direction
fields.evidence: CalculateOffset multiplies [3],[4],[5] by Length*frac. Live: (1 or -1, 0, 0) - a unit vector. operator= (GameEngine.dll+0x6323E0) copies +0xC as 8 bytes + +0x14 as 4.

fields.name: Radius
fields.evidence: Update: (*(float*)(c+0x18) + camera radius)^2 compared with ls::distanceFromLineSq of the scroll segment - the object's bound radius (set right after ls::Bound::GetRadius in the creation path). Live: always 0.

fields.name: Length
fields.evidence: CalculateOffset: divisor of (Speed*Time+Phase) and factor of Direction; skipped when |Length| < 1e-7. Live: 250, 12000.

fields.name: Speed
fields.evidence: CalculateOffset: [8] multiplies the double time at +0x28. Live: 5, 400.

fields.name: Phase
fields.evidence: CalculateOffset: [9] added to Speed*Time before the division by Length (a starting distance). Live: 0, 25, 75, 2400.

fields.name: Time
fields.evidence: Update (GameEngine.dll+0x6349A0, lines ~548): *(double*)(c+0x28) += time::GetDeltaTimeForEntity(...); then used in the offset formula. Live: doubles around 2.5..3.9 (high dword 0x401E..0x407F).

open_questions: Game member names unknown (no replication field metadata in bg3.exe, no macOS field names); names are descriptive.
Time is a C++ double (8-byte floating point) declared as uint64_t because double is not in the allowed primitive list; reinterpret the bits.
